g.text: The Sol's RNG Wiki as a fast desktop app that works offline.
Every aura, biome, gear and cutscene + a real-chance Auto Roll.
› roll for glorious, transcendent and beyond
› every aura with chance, biome and cutscene
› new auras arrive without a new exe
and the biome cycle – like in-game.
Live codes and badge stats. New auras
and app updates arrive by themselves.
recipe for all 498 auras, tier colors included.
After the first start the wiki runs offline –
only codes, badges and updates go online.
Hit Auto Roll in the main menu and chase
every tier with real chances, luck boosts,
cycle – only auras you can really roll.
The app is not code-signed – click
More info → Run anyway. Only once.
Start the app – a notice offers the new version
and installs it right inside the app.
Q Does it touch the game?
No. It is its own program and never
interacts with Roblox or your account.
click a row to open it
